description: PHASE 4 SLICE 2 — QUOTE-POSTS (a post that embeds/references another post). Model quote-posting cleanly and non-breakingly: a nullable quoted-post reference on Post, a NEW numbered migration 0010 adding a nullable posts.quoted_post_id self-referencing FK (never edit 0001-0009), compose support to attach a quoted post, PostCard rendering of an embedded quoted-post card, and repository mapping/persistence of the reference. Scope judgment per the briefing: deliver a SOLID quote-post (higher value than deep thread trees this phase); do NOT build deep multi-level reply-thread trees at the post level this phase (comment threading from Phase 1/FEAT-011 already covers conversational replies). Keep the quoted reference OPTIONAL and fully backward compatible: existing posts have a null quoted reference and render exactly as today. All SQL is verified by STRUCTURAL REVIEW only (no reachable Supabase).
steps: MODEL — lib/models/post.dart: add two optional fields: `final String? quotedPostId;` (the referenced post's id, the persisted FK) and `final Post? quotedPost;` (the hydrated embedded post for rendering, nullable and NOT part of ==/hashCode which stay id-based). Add both to the constructor (default null) and to copyWith (with a `bool clearQuotedPost` / `bool clearQuotedPostId` escape hatch mirroring the existing `clearMyReaction` pattern, since a null arg is indistinguishable from 'unchanged'). Document that quotedPostId is the durable reference and quotedPost is a hydrated convenience that may be null even when quotedPostId is set (e.g. the quoted post is not in cache / not viewable). deriveKind/attachments are unchanged: a quote-post is orthogonal to media kind (you can quote with a text body or with media). Preserve immutability + id-based equality. Guard against a post quoting ITSELF at the model layer is not required (enforce in compose/migration), but document the expectation.

MIGRATION — supabase/migrations/0010_quote_posts.sql (NEW; never edit 0001-0009): `alter table public.posts add column if not exists quoted_post_id uuid references public.posts(id) on delete set null;` (ON DELETE SET NULL so deleting a quoted post degrades the quoting post to a normal post rather than cascading a delete). Add a CHECK preventing self-quote guarded in a DO block (no `add constraint if not exists`): `alter table public.posts add constraint posts_no_self_quote check (quoted_post_id is null or quoted_post_id <> id);`. Add `create index if not exists idx_posts_quoted_post_id on public.posts (quoted_post_id);` for reverse lookups (who quoted X). NO new RLS policy is needed: the existing posts_select_viewable policy (0002) already gates each posts row by can_view_profile(auth.uid(), owner), and a joined quoted post is fetched as its own posts row subject to the SAME policy, so a viewer who cannot see the quoted post's author simply gets null for the embed. Head comment MUST document: purpose, the ON DELETE SET NULL rationale, the self-quote check, that no new RLS is required (inherits posts_select_viewable), and the ENV RISK that live application is UNVERIFIED here (no reachable/administerable Supabase) and validated by STRUCTURAL REVIEW ONLY. Idempotent (if not exists / guarded DO block for the constraint).

REPOSITORY MAPPING — lib/data/post_repository.dart: (a) update mapPostRow to read `row['quoted_post_id']` into Post.quotedPostId, and when the select joins the quoted post row (see step b) map that nested object into Post.quotedPost via the SAME mapping (a bounded, non-recursive one-level hydrate — the quoted post itself does NOT re-hydrate its own quoted post, to avoid unbounded nesting; document this one-level cap). Guard for a null/absent quoted join. (b) update the load()/loadMore() selects to fetch the quoted post one level deep. PostgREST self-referential embedding uses the FK-named hint: extend the select string to include `quoted:quoted_post_id(*, profiles(*), post_attachments(*))` (aliasing the self-join as `quoted`) and map `row['quoted']` in mapPostRow. Keep the existing `*, profiles(*), post_attachments(*), reactions(type)` columns. Document that the aliased self-embed shape is UNVERIFIED against live PostgREST (env risk) and that the mapper tolerates its absence (null embed) gracefully. (c) update _persistNewPost to include `'quoted_post_id': post.quotedPostId` in the inserted posts row (null for a normal post). Keep all persistence fire-and-forget + guarded.

POSTCARD EMBED — lib/widgets/post_card.dart: when post.quotedPost != null (or quotedPostId != null with a resolvable post), render a COMPACT embedded quoted-post card BELOW the caption and ABOVE/instead-of nothing (place it after the caption, before the media block or after it — choose after the caption and before the actions, inside a bordered rounded container matching AppColors.border + AppRadii): show the quoted author's avatar (small)/displayName/handle/verified badge, the quoted caption (truncated, linkified with the same shared grammar), and a small thumbnail if the quoted post has media (reuse the existing attachment image with the loading/error fallbacks; for a carousel show the first attachment). Tapping the embed should invoke an optional `onQuotedTap` callback (wire it in home_feed_screen to open the quoted post's comments/detail, mirroring onTap). If quotedPostId is set but quotedPost is null (not viewable/not cached), render a subtle 'This post is unavailable' placeholder card rather than nothing. Do NOT recurse: the embedded card must NOT itself render a nested quoted-post embed (one level only). Keep the outer card's header/actions unchanged.

COMPOSE — lib/screens/compose_screen.dart: add an OPTIONAL quoted-post entry point. Add a `Post? quoted` constructor parameter to ComposeScreen (default null) so a 'Quote' affordance on the repost/overflow path can open the composer pre-attached to a quoted post; when set, show a read-only compact preview of the quoted post (reuse the same embedded quoted-card widget from post_card, or a small local preview) above the toolbar, and build the composed Post with `quotedPostId: quoted.id` and `quotedPost: quoted`. A quote-post is postable when it has a quoted reference EVEN IF the text body is empty (quoting without commentary is valid), OR when it satisfies the normal text/attachment validity. Guard against quoting yourself is not required for the demo but avoid offering Quote on the viewer's own... (leave as product detail; do not block). Wire a 'Quote' action into the PostCard repost affordance or overflow menu that navigates to ComposeScreen(quoted: post). Mark the compose entry with a brief comment. Keep existing compose behavior for non-quote posts unchanged.

MOCKDATA — lib/data/mock_data.dart: add ONE quote-post seed exercising the model: a NEW post id (e.g. p13) authored by a user OUTSIDE {aria, jules} (to keep the Following subset unchanged) whose quotedPostId references an existing post (e.g. p2 or p9) and whose quotedPost is that same seed Post object, with a short commentary body. Place it LAST with the OLDEST createdAt so p1..p11(/p12) feed order/count/tie-break assertions and the Following subset are unaffected. Document the placement + self-reference-avoidance rationale in a comment. If adding it risks shifting an existing assertion, add the seed AND deliberately extend the affected test rather than weakening it.

TESTS — extend test/post_repository_test.dart (do NOT weaken existing assertions): (a) mapPostRow maps a row with `quoted_post_id` + a nested `quoted` object into a Post whose quotedPostId is set and whose quotedPost is the mapped embedded post (correct author/content/attachments), and the embedded post's OWN quotedPost is null (one-level cap); (b) a row with a `quoted_post_id` but NO nested `quoted` join maps to quotedPostId set + quotedPost null (unavailable/not-viewable case); (c) a row with neither maps to both null (normal post, unchanged). Add test/post_test.dart (or extend post_attachment_test.dart) covering Post.copyWith carrying/ clearing quotedPost/quotedPostId (clearQuotedPost / clearQuotedPostId escape hatches) and that == / hashCode remain id-based and are NOT affected by the quoted fields. Confirm existing feed-order/count tests still pass unchanged.

DOCS + VERIFY — update README.md to document quote-posts (nullable quoted_post_id self-FK, one-level embed hydrate, ON DELETE SET NULL, no new RLS needed, unavailable-embed placeholder). Run: export the 3 toolchain env vars then `flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test`. `flutter analyze` MUST report 'No issues found!' (zero issues) and `flutter test` MUST pass (FEAT-012 total + new). Confirm migrations 0001-0009 are byte-for-byte unchanged (git diff --stat) and only 0010 is added. Discard the auto-appended analysis_options.yaml exclude block via `git checkout analysis_options.yaml` before committing.
acceptance_criteria: Post carries nullable quotedPostId + quotedPost with copyWith clear escape hatches; ==/hashCode stay id-based and ignore the quoted fields

supabase/migrations/0010_quote_posts.sql adds posts.quoted_post_id (nullable self-FK, ON DELETE SET NULL) + a guarded self-quote CHECK + an index, is idempotent, needs no new RLS (inherits posts_select_viewable), and documents the ENV RISK; migrations 0001-0009 are byte-for-byte unchanged

mapPostRow hydrates a one-level quoted embed (aliased `quoted` self-join), tolerates its absence (quotedPost null), and does NOT recurse a second level; _persistNewPost writes quoted_post_id; load/loadMore select the quoted embed

PostCard renders a compact embedded quoted-post card (author/caption/thumbnail, linkified with the shared grammar) below the caption, an 'unavailable' placeholder when the embed can't be resolved, and never nests a second-level embed; compose can create a quote-post (postable even with empty body when a quote is attached)

New + extended tests pass (mapPostRow quoted present/absent/none; copyWith quoted carry/clear; id-based equality unaffected); existing assertions pass unchanged; `flutter analyze` clean (zero issues) + `flutter test` green
verification: export HOME=/tmp/fakehome PATH="/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH" PUB_CACHE=/opt/pub-cache && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test

Confirm via read: post.dart quoted fields + copyWith clears + id-based equality; 0010 migration self-FK/on-delete-set-null/self-quote-check/index/idempotency/env-risk comment; mapPostRow one-level embed + null tolerance; post_card embedded card is non-recursive; git diff --stat shows 0001-0009 unchanged and only 0010 added
Confirm analysis_options.yaml has no committed exclude block (git status clean of it)
findings: Implemented QUOTE-POSTS on branch feat/phase4-text-and-infinity-feed. (1) lib/models/post.dart: added `final String? quotedPostId` (durable FK) + `final Post? quotedPost` (hydrated embed, NOT in ==/hashCode which stay id-based). Both added to the constructor (default null) and to copyWith with `clearQuotedPostId`/`clearQuotedPost` escape hatches mirroring clearMyReaction (null arg == unchanged). Documented that quotedPost may be null even when quotedPostId is set (not viewable/not cached), that hydration is one-level (a quoted post's own quotedPost is always null), and that quote is orthogonal to media kind. (2) supabase/migrations/0010_quote_posts.sql (NEW; 0001-0009 byte-for-byte unchanged, git diff --stat shows only 0010 added): `add column if not exists quoted_post_id uuid references public.posts(id) on delete set null`, a guarded DO-block `posts_no_self_quote` CHECK (mirroring follows_status_check), and `create index if not exists idx_posts_quoted_post_id`. Head comment documents purpose, ON DELETE SET NULL rationale, self-quote check, no-new-RLS (inherits posts_select_viewable), and the ENV RISK that live application is UNVERIFIED (structural review only). Idempotent. (3) lib/data/post_repository.dart: mapPostRow gained a `bool embedQuoted = true` param — it reads row['quoted_post_id'] into quotedPostId and maps a nested aliased `quoted` Map into quotedPost via the SAME mapper with embedQuoted:false (ONE LEVEL only, no recursion; the embed still carries its own quotedPostId FK but a null quotedPost). Null/absent join tolerated (quotedPost null). load()/loadMore() selects extended with `quoted:quoted_post_id(*, profiles(*), post_attachments(*))` alongside the existing columns (documented UNVERIFIED against live PostgREST). _persistNewPost writes 'quoted_post_id': post.quotedPostId. All persistence stays fire-and-forget/guarded/single-notify. (4) lib/widgets/post_card.dart: added optional `onQuotedTap` + `onQuote` callbacks. Extracted `_linkify` into a shared top-level `linkifyEntities(text)` (same #/@ grammar) reused by the outer caption and the embed. New public `QuotedEmbedCard` widget (also reused by compose) renders a compact bordered (AppColors.border + AppRadii) card after the caption: small avatar + displayName + handle + verified badge, truncated linkified caption, and a 16:9 thumbnail via the existing _AttachmentImage (first attachment for a carousel; loading/error fallbacks). When quotedPostId is set but quotedPost is null, a subtle '_QuotedUnavailable' ('This post is unavailable') placeholder renders. NON-RECURSIVE (embed never renders a nested embed). Overflow menu (`_PostOverflowMenu`) now always renders (was collapsed on own posts) with a 'Quote' item first (shown whenever onQuote != null) and the mute/block/report items gated by !isOwnPost — so a user can quote any post including their own, but can't self-mute/block/report. (5) lib/screens/compose_screen.dart: added optional `Post? quoted` ctor param; reused QuotedEmbedCard as a read-only preview above the toolbar; _canPost now postable when a quote is attached OR attachments present (both only require !isOverLimit) else validateTextPost.isValid; _post() builds the Post with quotedPostId: quoted.id + quotedPost: quoted. Non-quote behavior unchanged. Wired onQuote in home_feed_screen to Navigator.push(ComposeScreen(quoted: post), fullscreenDialog:true); onQuotedTap opens the quoted post's comments when quotedPost != null. (6) lib/data/mock_data.dart: added p13 (author marco, OUTSIDE {aria,jules}) quoting p2 (quotedPostId 'p2' + a hydrated quotedPost copy of p2, never itself), short commentary, placed LAST with the OLDEST createdAt (now - 1d12h, older than p12) so p1..p12 ordering/counts and the Following subset are unaffected; rationale documented in a comment. (7) test/post_repository_test.dart: added 'mapPostRow quote-posts' group (nested quoted => quotedPostId set + quotedPost mapped with correct author/content/attachments/kind + embedded quotedPost null; two-level nesting proves the one-level cap keeps embed.quotedPost null while embed.quotedPostId is set; quoted_post_id without a join => embed null; neither => both null) and a 'Post.copyWith quote-post fields' group (carry forward, clearQuotedPost/clearQuotedPostId escape hatches, ==/hashCode stay id-based and ignore quoted fields). Existing assertions unchanged. (8) README.md: added a 'Quote-posts' subsection documenting the model, migration 0010 (self-FK, ON DELETE SET NULL, guarded check, no new RLS, env risk), one-level embed, rendering + unavailable placeholder, and compose. VERIFICATION: env vars exported; `flutter pub get` ok; `flutter analyze` => 'No issues found!' (zero); `flutter test` => All tests passed (235 total; 228 baseline + 7 new). analysis_options.yaml kept clean (git checkout run defensively; nothing to commit). Migrations 0001-0009 byte-for-byte unchanged, only 0010 added. No new packages. No push/PR performed. ENV RISK: SQL 0010 and the aliased self-embed PostgREST join shape could not be exercised (no reachable/administerable Supabase) — validated by structural review only.
